guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step installing python3.12 and related packages: 'E: Unable to locate package python3.12'. This indicates that Ubuntu 22.04's default repositories do not include python3.12 packages, likely because Python 3.12 is not available by default on Ubuntu 22.04. To fix this, consider one of the following approaches: (1) Use the default python3 version available on Ubuntu 22.04 (which is Python 3.10) by installing python3, python3-venv, python3-distutils, etc., instead of python3.12; or (2) Add a suitable PPA or custom repo to enable python3.12 packages, for example deadsnakes PPA, before installing python3.12 packages. Alternatively, install Python 3.12 from source or via pyenv, but adding deadsnakes PPA is simpler in Docker context. Be sure also to update all python version dependent commands accordingly, including update-alternatives to point to the installed Python version. Include this fixed installation in the apt-get install step and update references to python3.12 accordingly. Original error messages include: 'E: Unable to locate package python3.12', 'E: Unable to locate package python3.12-venv', 'E: Unable to locate package python3.12-distutils'.
